raw_metadata.note: Verification-friendly reference: stats mirror the Python reimplementation (scripts/run_risk_parity_backtest.py, lean_statistics=True, risk_free_rate=0.025) because the PDF only provides summary statistics and the framework does not support missing fields. True PDF/LEAN summary stats are stored in pdf_stats; LEAN ground truth in lean_ground_truth. Audit 2026-09-08 vs LEAN ground truth (Sleepy Tan Coyote orders/trades/logs): fills median 0.002% vs QC MOC; regimes 15/16 logged points; vol +/-11bp; 2%-gate suppresses 6 sub-2% legs on entry exactly as QC; order-ledger end PV within 0.06% of QC end equity. Two reimplementation bugs fixed: (1) fills now rebalance-day CLOSE (MarketOnClose) instead of open; (2) SMA(200) hedge gated on IsReady (200 bars since 2015-08-04, was firing spuriously Feb-2016). Docs-resolved (LEAN source Common/Statistics/Statistics.cs + PortfolioStatistics.cs via Context7/GitHub): performance = calendar-day equity returns (weekends flat), annual return = (1+daily_mean)^252-1, sample variance; Sharpe/Sortino subtract the average risk-free rate (~2.5%/yr 2016-2024). Verified: ledger curve prices at vol 0.0872 = QC exactly; Sharpe 0.3719 / Sortino 0.3901 at rf~=0.025. Residual gap to LEAN (ret 0.786 vs 0.938, DD -25.8% vs -17.7%) is one knife-edge month: 2020-03 hedge trigger (SPY vs SMA200x0.98) flips on QC-internal indicator state although closes match to 1.00000; forcing the QC hedge reproduces LEAN (ret 0.992, vol 0.0860, Sharpe 0.3802, Sortino 0.3972, DD -17.1%).

pdf_gate.comment: D7: the PDF summary is the parity gate (the top-level stats mirror the reimplementation and can never fail on their own). Wide tolerance: the PDF has no trade list and LEAN differs in methodology/fees/timing.
